summary: All 15 verification items pass. I pushed JenkinsPipelineUtils a43f45e, ArgoCDTools c32a27c and PrometheusDeploy 5a680b4, in that order. IaC/ArgoCDTools #15 ran stage Test (58 + 63 tests OK) before both kaniko stages and published argocd-hook:15 and aac-tools:15; AaC/PrometheusDeploy #5 and IaC/Build-Main #207 are green, and prd's prometheus-prd stayed Synced/Healthy with no sync.
